data.name: Manoranjan
data.gender_notes: Manoranjan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manoranjan is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'delight' or 'pleasure'. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Krishna, who is known for his enchanting and joyful nature. The name is believed to bestow happiness and joy upon the bearer. The name Manoranjan carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manoranjan usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with joy and pleasure.
data.etymology: Manoranjan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manoranjan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
